baseline.note: the defaults: layout current, 5 chunks a turn, the last three questions in the search text of a follow-up

tool-retrieval.note: search before the first turn only; later turns call search_documents

rewrite.note: turns with history search for a model-rewritten standalone query

cosine.note: vector ranking alone, no BM25 leg

bm25.note: full-text ranking alone, no vector leg

context-all-k5.note: excerpts accumulate as before (KV reused end to end) with today's k and search text: the layout control

shipped-0920.note: what serve did before 2026-09-21: excerpts of every turn stay in the context, 3 chunks a turn, the question alone as the search text

budget-8k.note: layout current with a context budget: the excerpts stay in the cached prefix until the context crosses 8k, then one clean prefill

budget-5k.note: as budget-8k, compacting twice as often

direct-k5.note: the direct addon engine: the cached state holds the bare conversation, this turn's excerpts live in a throwaway key (docs/todo-5.md)

discard-all-8k.note: the same on half the context, so the window fires from the fourth or fifth turn of a session instead of only on the longest ones

all-8k-nodiscard.note: the control for discard-all-8k: same layout and context, window off, so the turn that crosses 8192 throws context overflow and takes the session's KV state with it

tools-in-system.note: the tool declarations are written into the system prompt, which the prime protects, instead of being handed to the SDK; calls are read out of the model's text (docs/todo-6.md)

tools-in-system-discard.note: discard-all-8k with the declarations in the system prompt: the 439 tokens a turn the evictable block costs should go away
